extracted.intended_audience: general public, potential supporters/donors, partner organizations, and prospective clients
extracted.subtask_description: An informational 'About' page for a nonprofit environmental law firm that explains mission, scope of work, clients, history, capacity, and impact for a broad public audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission statement / core purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: A 501(c)3 nonprofit environmental law firm, Earthjustice has a passionate belief that the power of the law can be used to preserve the environment and build a healthier future for all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concisely state organizational mission and the role of law in achieving environmental and public health goals; present mission in audience‑facing, value-driven language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on high-stakes, precedent-setting litigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Earthjustice takes on the major environmental and public health fights — high-stakes legal cases where precedents and landmark outcomes will have an enduring, positive impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize selection of cases for systemic impact and long‑term outcomes; communicate commitment to cases that shape policy and law rather than only individual disputes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro bono representation model
rubrics_metrics.description: Because we represent our clients free of charge — thanks to the generous, continued support of individuals and foundations — an investment in Earthjustice has double the impact, supporting both Earthjustice and the organizations we represent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make clear whether clients are represented without fee; explain donor leverage/impact to potential supporters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track record / landmark cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Our lawyers are working on more than 600 legal cases. Areas of casework include protecting threatened wildlife, restoring clean air and water, protecting people from pesticides and other toxic chemicals, reining in our dependence on fossil fuels, strengthening the rise of clean energy, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List areas of active casework and quantify caseload to convey scale; highlight representative landmark victories or a link to '50 of our landmark cases' for evidence of impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Longevity and organizational history
rubrics_metrics.description: Earthjustice was founded in 1971... Initially known as the Sierra Club Legal Defense Fund, Earthjustice was always a separate entity from the Sierra Club. We changed our name to Earthjustice in 1997 to better reflect our role as a legal advocate for a diverse, and growing, group of clients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide founding date, evolution, and historical roots to establish credibility and institutional memory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence from member organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Initially known as the Sierra Club Legal Defense Fund, Earthjustice was always a separate entity from the Sierra Club.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify organizational independence from similarly named or affiliated groups to avoid confusion about governance and clients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charity transparency and ratings
rubrics_metrics.description: We have been awarded Charity Navigator’s top rating for the past fourteen consecutive years. Only 1% of charities that are evaluated have received at least 14 consecutive years of 4-star evaluations. Earthjustice's exceptional designation from Charity Navigator demonstrates to the public its sustained trustworthiness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite third‑party evaluations and multi‑year ratings to support claims of financial health, accountability, and trustworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Client types and diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: We represent community groups, national nonprofits, Tribes, and many more... Our clients encompass grassroots groups to national nonprofits, such as the American Lung Association, Sierra Club, and NRDC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the range of clients served (grassroots to national organizations, Tribes, individuals) and provide examples to illustrate diversity of representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic and jurisdictional scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Earthjustice's attorneys litigate in federal and state judicial and administrative forums, as well as in state utility commissions... Our 15 offices provide regional emphasis and expertise across the country. Additionally, an International Program works with organizations around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify where the organization operates (offices, national/international reach) and the forums in which it litigates or advocates to show capacity to act across jurisdictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmatic issue areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs focused on Biodiversity Defense, Clean Energy, Community Partnerships, Fossil Fuels, Oceans, Sustainable Food & Farming, Toxic Exposure & Health, and Tribal Partnerships take on pressing challenges in these issue areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List program names and short descriptors to show organizational priorities and expertise areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy and legislative advocacy capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: On Capitol Hill, our Policy & Legislation team advocate on behalf of the public's interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note separate policy/legislation teams and their role in advocacy beyond litigation to convey multi‑front strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Staffing and technical capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: More than 600 staff members, including more than 220 full-time attorneys... Our team also includes legal and research analysts, policy and legislation experts, staff scientists, communications staff... and development officers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide headcount and composition (attorneys, scientists, policy experts, communications, development) to demonstrate multidisciplinary capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact claims / examples of benefits to the public
rubrics_metrics.description: Earthjustice's legal victories have cleaned up the air we breathe, banned some of the most dangerous chemicals from our food and homes, saved hundreds of threatened species, preserved centuries-old forests from logging, and much, much more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support impact statements with concrete examples or links to case outcomes to substantiate broad claims about public benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founding model and inspiration
rubrics_metrics.description: The NAACP Legal Defense and Education Fund... was the model for Earthjustice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explaining the founding model or inspiration can communicate mission alignment with successful historical precedents and shape credibility.
